description: Read measures from..to of a track of the draft (all by default, 200 at most a call: past them, the answer's more says where to go on) as a .cesure file writes them: measures, the measures of the piece (id, time signature and marks, repeat signs), and trackMeasures, the track's own, one in each (voices in the compact notation, second voice, hands, ties included; chord symbols) — with the tempo changes of those measures, by id, a summary of the score and one of the track.

draft.description: The draft: the id a previous tool gave (draft).

to.description: Last measure (default the last; at most 200 are read a call).

name: read_score
title: Read measures
